glosses: connection (the point at which two or more things are connected)
connection (a feeling of understanding between people)

examples.text: Tom no puede hacer su trabajo sin conexión a Internet.
examples.en: Tom can't do his job without an internet connection.

examples.text: Me cortaron la conexión a Internet.
examples.en: My internet connection was cut off.

examples.text: No tiene conexión una cosa con la otra.
examples.en: There's no connection between the two things.

examples.text: Tiene que haber una conexión entre estos asesinatos.
examples.en: There must be a connection between these murders.

examples.text: Ha de haber una conexión entre estos asesinatos.
examples.en: There must be a connection between these murders.
